meta.title: Public speech networks — multipolar online coalitions
meta.method: Open-source posts on X (public handles only). Edges are documented public speech interactions or co-presence in public threads. Centrality is not guilt. Allegations by third parties are labeled ALLEGATION.
meta.disclaimer: This board maps public online speech. It is not a finding of criminal association, intelligence employment, or conspiracy. Legal names attributed by third parties remain unverified unless independently sourced.

findings.title: Multipolar, not a single cell
findings.text: Public speech forms at least two gravity wells (a dense multi-year hub and a companion conflict wing) plus an outer viral orbit. Support often travels via shared adversaries rather than mutual praise between hubs.

findings.title: Bridge accounts matter more than raw follower counts
findings.text: A small set of accounts appear in more than one wing with supportive or co-combat speech. Those bridges explain why the network feels connected without proving unified command.

findings.title: Null edges are findings
findings.text: Absence of bilateral public posts between some high-profile pairs is itself material. Do not invent coordination where the public record is empty.

findings.title: Centrality is not guilt
findings.text: A well-connected node is a well-documented speech node. Conclusions require case files, primary documents, and independent verification — not graph aesthetics.

findings.title: A public pressure campaign is itself a mappable event
findings.text: @ProjPM (Barrett Brown) is running a visible naming and pressure campaign: alias collapse, crowd-sourced identity confirmation, screenshot posts, and asset/fed labels aimed at @FuxNet and related scene names. That he is saying these things is a public fact; each substantive claim remains a separate verification task.

methods_public: Open call for identity confirmation via bio email
Screenshot posts purporting private or third-party speech
Serialized pressure threads against other named accounts
barrett_campaign.note: Campaign inventory is for organization of public speech. Do not treat Barrett assertions as proven institutional findings.
